title: Source-Channel Identifiability in Aging Biomolecular Communication: An Information-Theoretic Audit

creators.name: Devanik Debnath
creators.affiliation: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, National Institute of Technology Agartala, India

description: A theoretical and computational methods preprint formalizing source-channel identifiability for aging-related biomolecular communication. It provides an exact reference-distribution decomposition and a reproducible synthetic binary-channel audit. It contains no biological dataset and makes no clinical claim.
notes: Prepared deposition metadata only. No Zenodo upload or DOI minting has occurred.
